name: collapse-tools
description: Collapse tool calls in the transcript; click the chevron to expand or collapse

enabled.title: Collapse tool calls
enabled.description: Turn off to show tool calls as Claude Code normally does

expandedTools.title: Tools kept expanded
expandedTools.description: Comma-separated tool names that start expanded

collapseOwnSubagents.title: Collapse subagents
collapseOwnSubagents.description: Start Agent calls collapsed, hiding their nested tool calls and the report a background subagent hands back

collapseFailed.title: Collapse failed calls
collapseFailed.description: Start failed and refused tool calls collapsed too, marked with ✗

collapseOtherAgents.title: Collapse messages from other agents
collapseOtherAgents.description: Start messages from teammates and other Claude sessions collapsed
